### Story Details
#### S001 - Fraud Network Cold-Start
- Situation: A cross-institution fraud network stalled at onboarding; members went quiet.
- Action: Changed the contribution model to accept true-positive alerts and made signal operator-configurable.
- Result: True-positive alert volume went from ~9 to early 100s within ~2.5 months.

#### S002 - AI Agents in Regulated Workflows
- Situation: Investigators resisted AI in audited fraud workflows.
- Action: Eval-driven build from customer SOPs; architecture chosen to remove the per-customer legal barrier.
- Result: 100+ enterprise customers; 35-65% handle-time reduction; no exits for legal/security reasons.

#### S003 - Privacy-Preserving Data Sharing
- Situation: No institution would contribute raw PII to a shared datastore.
- Action: Ran 150 discovery calls, sourced privacy-preserving-record-linkage experts, designed a one-way hash.
- Result: Co-patent granted; live consortium product.
